MAGICSWORDSMAN-SUMMONING_DRAUGHT.title: Summoning Draught
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SUMMONING_DRAUGHT.descrip:
Choose one of your swords that has not come out this combat, summon it and make it your [gold]current sword[/gold].
Put {Cards} random cards of that sword from your draw pile into your hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-PURIFYING_WATER.title: Purifying Water
MAGICSWORDSMAN-PURIFYING_WATER.descripti:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Status and Curse cards in your hand.
Remove 1 of your debuffs.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-QUENCHING_WATER.title: Quenching Water
MAGICSWORDSMAN-QUENCHING_WATER.descripti: This combat, your [gold]current sword[/gold] counts as {Levels} levels higher (max 5). If you have no current sword, choose one of your swords.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-BLADE_ESSENCE.title: Blade Essence
MAGICSWORDSMAN-BLADE_ESSENCE.description: This turn, sword cards in your hand cost {CostReduction} less (min 0).
